StatDef.label: service quality
StatDef.description: How pleasant this person is to be served by. Added to the satisfaction of guests they talk to, and read by shops, kitchens and the front desk.

StatDef.label: hosting learning
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the social experience gained while hosting guests.

StatDef.label: guest expectation
StatDef.description: Added to what a guest expects from a stay. Positive means harder to please. Charm and good manners lower it; a refined palate raises it.

StatDef.label: gambling joy
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the joy this person draws from gambling.

StatDef.label: gambling addiction chance
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the chance that gambling becomes an addiction. Zero means this person never gets hooked.

StatDef.label: sleight of hand
StatDef.description: Skill levels added to fine hand work at tables: dealing, shuffling, and house cheating.

StatDef.label: counting skill
StatDef.description: Skill levels added when working as croupier, cashier or bank clerk.

StatDef.label: fraud detection
StatDef.description: Multiplier on noticing forged chips, cheating guests and short-changing.

StatDef.label: theft in their room
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the chance that something is stolen in a room this person looks after.

StatDef.label: brawl risk around them
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the chance of a quarrel turning into a fight in this person's room.

StatDef.label: rumour spread
StatDef.description: Multiplier on how far stories about the house travel, good or bad.

StatDef.label: care progress
StatDef.description: Multiplier on patient and rehab progress while this person looks after them.

StatDef.label: bank fees
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the fees the bank charges this person.

StatDef.label: negotiation bonus
StatDef.description: Added to insurance and contract negotiations.

StatDef.label: recruitment surcharge
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the surcharge above the price floor when buying a guest's loyalty.

StatDef.label: tiredness while serving
StatDef.description: Multiplier on how fast rest drains while waiting tables or serving at a counter.

StatDef.label: tips
StatDef.description: Multiplier on the tips this person leaves as a guest.

StatDef.label: dish quality chance
StatDef.description: Chance to lift the quality of a cooked dish by one step.

StatDef.label: family cheer
StatDef.description: Added to the satisfaction of families and children in this person's care.

StatDef.label: price feel
StatDef.description: Added to how expensive guests find this person's prices.
